what: Query Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 with DuckDB
title: Query Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 with DuckDB
text: quak provides convenient utilities using DuckDB datasets stored Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 (abfss://). opens connections configured Azure-backed Delta Lake data, registers Azure credentials DuckDB secrets, works SQL via DBI lazy table queries via dplyr dbplyr.

title: Query Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 with DuckDB
text: quak yet CRAN. Install development version GitHub:
code: # install.packages("remotes") remotes::install_github("pedrobtz/quak")

title: Query Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 with DuckDB
text: Start opening Azure-ready DuckDB connection. register one Azure secret connection. Use credential chain want DuckDB resolve credentials , example Azure CLI: Use access token another package obtains token : Use service principal want pass application credentials directly: secret helpers also accept account = "storageaccount" scope secret one storage account.
code: library(quak)  conn <- az_conn() library(quak)  conn <- az_conn() az_set_chain_secret(conn, chain = "cli") library(quak)  az_creds <- azr::DefaultCredential$new(   scope = az_default_scope() )  conn <- az_conn() az_set_token_secret(conn, token = az_creds$get_token()$access_token) library(quak)  conn <- az_conn() az_set_sp_secret(   conn,   tenant_id = Sys.getenv("AZURE_TENANT_ID"),   client_id = Sys.getenv("AZURE_CLIENT_ID"),   client_secret = Sys.getenv("AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET") )

title: Query Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 with DuckDB
text: Use load_delta() want register Delta table DuckDB query SQL.
code: library(quak)  conn <- az_conn() az_set_chain_secret(conn, chain = "cli")  load_delta(   conn = conn,   url = "abfss://container@account/path/sales",   name = "sales",   method = "view" )  DBI::dbGetQuery(   conn,   "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount    FROM sales    WHERE amount > 100" )  DBI::dbDisconnect(conn, shutdown = TRUE)

title: Query Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 with DuckDB
text: Use tbl_delta() want work Delta table dplyr/dbplyr.
code: library(quak)  conn <- az_conn() az_set_chain_secret(conn, chain = "cli")  sales <- tbl_delta(conn, "abfss://container@account/path/sales")  sales |>   dplyr::filter(amount > 100) |>   dplyr::summarise(avg_amount = mean(amount, na.rm = TRUE)) |>   dplyr::collect()  DBI::dbDisconnect(conn, shutdown = TRUE)

title: Install a DuckDB extension — ext_install
text: name Character scalar. Extension name. cache ext_cache object used manual fallback. repo "core" "community". Determines configured URL use , URL set, DuckDB install syntax emit. conn DuckDB connection. Defaults conn_default(). verbose Logical NULL. TRUE, emits warning SQL install fails manual fallback succeeds. NULL (default), uses quak.install_verbose option / QUAK_INSTALL_VERBOSE env var. FALSE, fallback silent. Either way, SQL failure never raised error .

title: Install a DuckDB extension — ext_install
text: Invisibly returns conn.

title: Install a DuckDB extension — ext_install
text: SQL install: runs DuckDB's built-INSTALL (using configured repository URL one set via repo_set_urls(), QUAK_CORE_REPO / QUAK_COMMUNITY_REPO env vars, quak.core_repo / quak.community_repo R options). Manual fallback: SQL install fails (e.g. DuckDB reach HTTPS URL httpfs loaded, whereas R's curl can), downloads .duckdb_extension file, caches , copies extension directory. SQL failure never raised — surfaces (warning, verbose = TRUE) manual fallback also runs. error raised strategies fail. Idempotent — skips install extension already installed (checked via duckdb_extensions() pragma).

title: Install a DuckDB extension — ext_install
